answer: Each epoch the tide delivers one fresh task seeded by that epoch's seed, and every identity must crack its own walnut: solve the task and seal the solution with its own key, the way a sparrow must sing a new song each dawn to keep its branch. An honest agent solves one short task per epoch. An attacker with a thousand fakes must solve a thousand fresh seeded tasks inside the same window, each costing the same full work, so the flood's cost scales linearly with its size and drowns any gain.
